purpose: Prospectively freeze the candidate-independent procedure for translating generic Tier-1 raw quote evidence into a Discovery execution-cost confidence rule without selecting a numeric fill/staleness/slippage rule before observing quote dynamics.
selection_process: Summarize the permitted measurements across the complete candidate-independent DEVELOPMENT quote domain before opening C006/C012 economic outcomes.
Assess whether candidate MARKET_PROXY timing can be paired with a credible coarse spread/slippage/delay cost treatment without replacing the frozen OHLC MARKET_PROXY price/timing.
Prefer genuinely applicable verified evidence when the historical quote evidence supports it.
Otherwise define only a defensible adverse conservative bound supported by the generic evidence. Do not choose a bound from candidate economic sign, returns, PnL, or signals.
If reasonable execution-cost uncertainty can change economic sign, classify COST_UNRESOLVED.
Freeze the resulting Discovery execution-cost rule and its evidence provenance before any C006/C012 economic outcome is opened.
Exact Certification execution remains a later stricter gate and is not established by this protocol.
conservative_rule_requirements: Must be prospectively frozen before the affected candidate economic outcome.
Must be applicable to the candidate execution context while remaining distinct from the candidate MARKET_PROXY price/timing.
Must use an adverse credible treatment such that uncertainty cannot falsely promote a failing candidate.
May not credit favorable unverified execution, spread, delay, or slippage assumptions.
If reasonable uncertainty can change sign, the only permitted conclusion is UNRESOLVED.
candidate_identity_rule: If credible Stage-A MARKET_PROXY execution-cost approximation cannot be established, readiness remains BLOCKED/COST_UNRESOLVED. Candidate entry definitions/hashes are not mutated.
certification_rule: Certification requires later stricter exact execution/cost validation; Discovery calibration does not satisfy Certification execution truth.
